Q3027038.label: Didier Guillaume
Q3027038.img: Didier Guillaume during the Paris Agricultural Show - 2019 (cropped).jpg
Q3027038.summary: Didier Guillaume was a French politician who briefly served as minister of state of Monaco from 2024 until his death in 2025. He previously served as the minister of agriculture and food in the government of Prime Minister Édouard Philippe from 2018 to 2020. A member of the Socialist Party until 2018, he was President of the General Council of Drôme from 2004 to 2015, Senator for Drôme from 2008 to 2018 and president of the Socialist group in the Senate from 2014 to 2018.

Q6543966.label: Liechtenstein citizenship referendum, 1986
Q6543966.summary: A referendum on citizenship was held in Liechtenstein on 7 December 1986. Voters were asked whether they approved of a proposal on acquiring and losing citizenship. It was approved by 52.0% of voters.

Q690782.label: 2003 Swiss federal election
Q690782.desc: election to the federal parliament in Switzerland
Q690782.summary: Federal elections were held in Switzerland on 19 October 2003. Although in Switzerland's political system, in which all four major parties form a coalition, it is very difficult to achieve a change of government, this election produced an upset with the strong showing of the right-wing, anti-European Union and anti-immigration Swiss People's Party.

Q2358366.label: Omagh bombing
Q2358366.desc: car bombing in Northern Ireland in 1998
Q2358366.img: Lower Market Street, Omagh County Tyrone.jpg
Q2358366.summary: A car bombing took place in the town of Omagh in County Tyrone, Northern Ireland on 15 August 1998. It was carried out by the Real Irish Republican Army, a Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) splinter group who opposed the IRA's ceasefire and the Good Friday Agreement, signed earlier in the year.

Q236126.label: Hurricane Gustav
Q236126.summary: Hurricane Gustav was the second most destructive tropical cyclone of the 2008 Atlantic hurricane season. The seventh tropical cyclone, third hurricane, and second major hurricane of the season, Gustav caused serious damage and casualties in Haiti, the Dominican Republic, Jamaica, the Cayman Islands, Cuba and the United States.
